case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 844 OF 2023 (@ SLP (Crl) No. 2984 OF 2018)
summary: Sentence reduction appeal; conviction under IPC s.304A upheld; rash and negligent driving causing death; ambulance overturned; High Court improperly reduced sentence from two years to eight months based on accused's poverty; failure to consider gravity of offence, nature of injuries, and deterrent purpose of penal law; IPC sentencing principles (proportionality, societal impact) emphasized; payment of compensation not a valid mitigating factor when reducing sentence below statutory limits; criminal negligence vs civil liability distinction.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court's sentence reduction set aside; original two-year rigorous imprisonment restored.
